description: Read a cell range (A1 notation, e.g. 'Sheet1!A1:C10') from a spreadsheet as a 2D grid of values. Requires a connected account.
embedding_description: Read cell values out of an existing Google Sheets spreadsheet by spreadsheet id and an A1-notation range (for example 'Sheet1!A1:C10' or a bare 'Sheet1' for the whole tab). Returns a 2D grid (list of row lists) exactly as Sheets returns it — empty trailing cells are omitted per Google's convention. This is the read counterpart to sheets_update_values/sheets_append_values. Fails gsuite.not_found if the spreadsheet id does not exist.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with a values 2D grid (list of row lists).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Summarize the shape of the data (rows/columns) and show a few sample rows. Cell contents may be sensitive corporate data — treat as moderately sensitive.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Read a cell range from a Google Sheets spreadsheet.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params: missing id or range. gsuite.not_found: the spreadsheet id or range's sheet name does not exist. gsuite.not_connected: no account linked.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.invalid_params: supply both id and an A1-notation range. gsuite.not_found: verify the spreadsheet id and sheet/tab name. gsuite.not_connected: run connect_account.
